description_zh: 清晨采摘才有效，太阳一晒就蔫了。
description_en: Best picked at dawn; wilts the moment the sun hits it.

description_zh: 长在打坐的地方，据说吸收了不少坐功。
description_en: Grows where cultivators meditate. Allegedly absorbed some of their focus.

description_zh: 嚼一片，烦心事先放一边。
description_en: Chew one leaf and your worries take a break.

description_zh: 长得像萝卜，但灵气比萝卜浓。
description_en: Looks like a radish, but with a stronger trace of spirit energy.

description_zh: 没人确定能不能吃，但大家都吃了。
description_en: Nobody's sure if it's edible. Everyone eats it anyway.

description_zh: 路边随手就能捡到，品相一般。
description_en: Easily picked up roadside. Quality is average at best.

description_zh: 带着露水采摘，口感清凉。
description_en: Picked while still dewy. Refreshingly cool.

description_zh: 苦得让人清醒，专治犯困。
description_en: Bitter enough to snap you awake instantly.

description_zh: 吃完准打嗝，原因不明。
description_en: Guaranteed to make you hiccup. Reason unknown.

description_zh: 闻一闻就能安静下来，适合摸鱼。
description_en: One sniff and you're calm. Great for slacking off.

description_zh: 长歪了的灵芝，效果照样有，就是卖相差。
description_en: A crooked lingzhi. Works fine, just looks awkward.

description_zh: 三片叶子代表三分清气，传说而已。
description_en: Three leaves, three parts qi, or so the legend goes.

description_zh: 吃了胃口大开，修炼前先吃饱。
description_en: Sparks the appetite. Best eaten before training.

description_zh: 树上掉下来的，捡到就算是缘分。
description_en: Fell off a tree. Picking it up counts as fate.

description_zh: 武者练功时常受伤，这草专门止血。
description_en: A Warrior staple for stopping bleeding from training mishaps.

description_zh: 缠在身上没用，得炼成丹才有效。
description_en: Wrapping it around yourself does nothing; it must be brewed first.

description_zh: 晒得越久越烫手，采摘时小心。
description_en: Gets hotter the longer it sits in the sun. Handle with care.

description_zh: 捏一下会啪地响，吓人但没用。
description_en: Pops with a loud snap when squeezed. Startling, otherwise useless.

description_zh: 长得很疲惫的人参，据说是过劳长成的。
description_en: A tired-looking ginseng, allegedly grown from overwork.

description_zh: 花瓣硬得像铁片，闻着有股铁锈味。
description_en: Petals as hard as iron plates. Smells faintly of rust.

description_zh: 吃了走路会晃，据说打拳更准。
description_en: Makes you wobble when walking. Supposedly improves punch accuracy.

description_zh: 辣得让人想打人，慎用。
description_en: Spicy enough to make you want to punch something. Use with caution.

description_zh: 缠绕在突破关卡前的藤蔓，象征意义大于实际。
description_en: A vine found near breakthrough thresholds. More symbolic than scientific.

description_zh: 武者清晨练功时凝结的露水，带点汗味。
description_en: Dew collected during a Warrior's morning training. Faintly smells of sweat.

description_zh: 被雷劈过却没烧成炭，传说沾点运气。
description_en: Struck by lightning but didn't burn. Said to carry a bit of luck.

description_zh: 长在武者常年练功的地方，带点茧子的味道。
description_en: Grows where Warriors train for years. Smells faintly of calluses.

description_zh: 颜色发紫，据说是先天期专属灵芝。
description_en: A purple-tinged lingzhi, said to favor Innate-stage cultivators.

description_zh: 名字唬人，其实就是普通灵草。
description_en: A scary name for what is, frankly, a fairly ordinary herb.

description_zh: 花香能让经脉舒展一下，象征性疏通。
description_en: Its scent loosens the meridians, at least symbolically.

description_zh: 缠着灵气长大的藤，摸起来微微发烫。
description_en: A vine grown wrapped in spirit qi. Faintly warm to the touch.

description_zh: 一颗果子分三段，据说补三倍。
description_en: One fruit, three segments, said to give triple the benefit.

description_zh: 只在月圆夜采摘才有效，平时只是普通叶子。
description_en: Only effective when picked under a full moon. Otherwise just a leaf.

description_zh: 长在云雾缭绕的山顶，采摘要爬很久。
description_en: Grows atop misty peaks. Picking it means a long climb.

description_zh: 晚上会发光，没人敢第一个吃。
description_en: Glows at night. Nobody wanted to be the first to try it.

description_zh: 据说缠绕千年，性格也变得沉稳。
description_en: Said to have wrapped around the same tree for a thousand years. Quite calm now.

description_zh: 竹叶边缘锋利，采摘时务必小心手指。
description_en: The leaf edges are sharp. Mind your fingers while harvesting.

description_zh: 炼气期标志性灵草，市面上不便宜。
description_en: A signature herb of the Qi-Refining stage. Not cheap on the market.

description_zh: 据说花瓣能映出半片天空，玄学但好看。
description_en: Its petals are said to reflect half the sky. Mystical, at least pretty.

description_zh: 摸起来冰凉，据说能镇住浮躁的心。
description_en: Cool to the touch. Said to settle a restless mind.

description_zh: 据说要转九次才能长成，急脱根的那种。
description_en: Said to take nine growth cycles to mature. Quite the impatient root.

description_zh: 竹节里藏着一点灵气，敲开才看得到。
description_en: A bit of qi hides inside each bamboo joint. Must crack it open to see.

description_zh: 长在最舒服的阴凉处，名字很贴切。
description_en: Grows in the comfiest shade. The name fits perfectly.

description_zh: 九片叶子全齐才算合格，少一片就降级。
description_en: Needs all nine leaves intact to count as proper quality.

description_zh: 长在雷劫劈过的地方，带着一点焦味。
description_en: Grows where lightning tribulation struck. Faintly smells of char.

description_zh: 摘下来就开始变淡，得赶紧用。
description_en: Starts fading the moment it's picked. Use it quickly.

description_zh: 炼气期修士常互相赠送，据说能传情也能炼丹。
description_en: Cultivators often gift these to each other. Works for romance and alchemy alike.

description_zh: 筑基期专属灵根，据说扎得很深。
description_en: A root exclusive to the Foundation stage. Said to dig in deep.

description_zh: 颜色又紫又金，看着就很贵。
description_en: Purple and gold colored. Looks expensive just sitting there.

description_zh: 长在筑基期修士常去的池子边，花期很短。
description_en: Grows by ponds Foundation-stage cultivators frequent. Blooms briefly.

description_zh: 草茎硬得像铁，得用专门的工具采摘。
description_en: The stem is iron-hard. Needs special tools to harvest.

description_zh: 花心凝结出一点丹元气息，炼丹师都抢着要。
description_en: Its center holds a trace of core energy. Alchemists fight over it.

description_zh: 据说修士打坐久了也会加班，这草专为他们而生。
description_en: For cultivators who meditate so long it counts as overtime.

description_zh: 七种颜色轮流变换，拿在手里像彩虹糖。
description_en: Cycles through seven colors. Looks like a handful of rainbow candy.

description_zh: 没人给它正式命名，暂时就叫那个果子。
description_en: Nobody's bothered to officially name it. For now it's just called that fruit.

description_zh: 传说能引出金丹雏形，市面上几乎见不到。
description_en: Said to coax a golden core into form. Nearly impossible to find on the market.

description_zh: 名字一听就很贵，效果也确实不便宜。
description_en: The name alone sounds expensive. The effect matches the price tag.

description_zh: 九道阳气凝在一株草上，据说炼制时会发金光。
description_en: Nine strands of yang energy condensed into one grass. Said to glow gold while brewing.

description_zh: 据说是海龟呼出的气凝成的草，长寿气息很重。
description_en: Said to form from an ancient turtle's breath. Smells strongly of longevity.

description_zh: 果皮会反光，黑夜里像个小灯泡。
description_en: The skin reflects light, looking like a tiny lightbulb at night.

description_zh: 据说是打工人参修炼成精后的真身，传说级别的过劳产物。
description_en: The true form of Overtime Ginseng after years of cultivation. A legendary product of overwork.
